progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs3 and dwells most on D# in Kereshmeh. Kereshmeh ba Muyeh (0:13.0) introduces B, Ds, E, centred on B. The line peaks at E4 (332.2 Hz) at 0:47.9. It closes on D#4, not the tonic (B2 → D#4 → Ds4 → D#4 → E4 → D#4).
